collection.title: Cupra (SEAT) Ateca 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Cupra Ateca 2018 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Ateca which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
